sections.heading: Shared Vocabulary
sections.body: Teams move faster when they share words for vibes: beat, loop, repair path, momentum, and safety. We add these to our design reviews and code reviews. We ask: what beat are we shipping? Does the loop meet the budget? Where is the repair path?

sections.heading: Artifacts that Travel
sections.body: We create artifacts that work across roles: narrative briefs, loop diagrams, and vibe checklists. We keep them short and current. These documents reduce misunderstanding and make onboarding smoother.

sections.heading: Review Rituals
sections.body: We run vibe reviews alongside functional reviews. Someone narrates the story while another person measures timing. We verify copy tone and accessibility basics. Reviewers log both findings and feelings.

sections.heading: Healthy Tensions
sections.body: Vibe coding welcomes tension between speed and polish. The rule is to ship coherent vibes at each milestone, not half-finished feelings. We prioritize beats that uphold trust and defer decoration.

sections.heading: Exercises
sections.body: Add a vibe section to your pull request template. Include a narrative snippet, a timing budget, and what changed about safety. Rotate a 'vibe buddy' who focuses on user feelings during review.
